reviewer: Codex actual exported GLB visual and editable source review

views.front: Clear two-module left-chaise silhouette, separate plump back cushions, broad seat faces, padded arms and recessed timber feet. Both blue-grey tint and dimensions match the preserved baseline.
views.detail: Visible sewn boxing and localized corner tension survive export. Fine woven surface remains deliberately subtle at furniture distance, with restrained matte highlights rather than the baseline full-white sheen.
views.clay: Shaped backs, broad settled seats, rounded arm caps and narrow seams remain visible without texture. The long chaise cover widens around the arm nose, avoiding a large empty deck ledge.
views.rear: Two separate upholstered rear panels align with the transport-module split; the back cushions have depth and rake. Wood feet and consistent outer arm construction remain visible.
views.underside: Two inset dust covers, perimeter wood support rails and eight recessed feet form a coherent closed upholstery underside. Cushion boxing remains continuous around the chaise edge.

limitations: Approval is for this Beta review candidate, not a claim that the user has rated it 8/10.
Original measured adaptation of researched sectional construction, not a brand-exact replica.
Fabric030 is a CC0 approximation; its 0.28-metre repeat is artist-calibrated. Microfiber fuzz and dynamic cloth are not modeled.
Browser and Cycles are different renderers; each before/after comparison keeps the camera, lighting and tint equal.
No production catalog replacement or saved plan changes are included.
